def show_form(self, request):
    # --- validation & flash (errors) ---
    errors = self.validator.run(request.form)
    if errors:
        self.flash.store(request.session.id, errors)

    # --- history & analytics (navigation side effects) ---
    flag = self.flags.enabled('beta_ui') and request.browser.mobile
    self.history.push(request.session.id, request.path)
    self.analytics.track('view', {'form': request.path, 'mobile': flag})

    # --- render (combines both) ---
    return self.template.render(request.path, errors=errors, beta=flag)
